articles.title: That Y2K feeling: Why today's economy resembles 2000
articles.dek: It was an economy bursting at the seams: robust growth powered by a tech boom, low unemployment, elevated inflation and Fed rate hikes to try to cool things down. articles.title: Campbell hits 3 FGs as Western Kentucky defeats Sam Houston 16-3

articles.title: Obeid kicks 20-yard FG as time expires, Missouri State beats Kennesaw State 24-21

articles.title: Kaick Ferreira, Daniel De Sousa Brito help Dallas end Sounders' unbeaten run with 1-0 victory
articles.dek: Kaick Ferreira scored in the second half and Daniel De Sousa Britto made it stand up as FC Dallas beat Seattle 1-0 on Wednesday night, ending the Sounders' four-match win streak and an unbeaten run that reached nine.

articles.title: St. Louis City ties 'Caps 0-0, extends unbeaten streak in all competitions to MLS-record 21 games
articles.dek: Roman Bürki had his fourth shutout this season in a 0-0 tie with the Vancouver Whitecaps and St. Louis City extended its unbeaten streak in all competitions to an MLS-record 21 consecutive games.

articles.title: Union top Fire 3-1 for 8th straight victory during club-record 14-match unbeaten streak
articles.dek: Bruno Damiani netted two goals after Milan Iloski scored — all with a man advantage — and Cavan Sullivan set a teen record for goal contributions as the Philadelphia Union beat the Chicago Fire 3-1 for their eighth straight victory in a club-record 14-match unbeaten streak.

articles.title: Mukhtar and Nájar each have 1 goal, 1 assist, Nashville beats Sporting KC 4-0
articles.dek: Hany Mukhtar and Andy Nájar each had a goal and an assist, Sam Surridge also scored a goal and Nashville SC beat Sporting Kansas City 3-0 for their fourth consecutive win.
